# ReplicatedStorage

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- A **service**: get it with `game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")`
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`

A container for instances that every machine has but that are not part of the world: templates to clone, `RemoteEvent`s and other data. Nothing under it is drawn, collides or is simulated. It is saved with the scene, so what the editor puts there is there when the game starts.

In a multiplayer match, its contents replicate to every client at any distance. A client's copy is replaced by what the authority sends. Get it with `game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")`, and clone what should appear in the world into `Workspace`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
